mandate.summary: Protect capital. Keep peak-to-trough drawdown under 8% (soft target). Never exceed 12% (hard halt in risk-limits.json). Beat SPY on a risk-adjusted basis over rolling 3- and 6-month windows, measured as return per unit of max drawdown and volatility. Stretch goal: beat SPY's absolute total return over 12 months. Keep the process disciplined and auditable. Every position gets a written thesis, a hard stop and an invalidation level. Every week, grade trades against SPY over the same windows. logic.rationale: Exit triggered on the close. The 11/18 regular close was 181.18, below the 184.5 trail (ratcheted 11/13 under the post-advance base and above entry). That is 1.8% through the line, so not marginal. The intraday low of 180.74 undercut the 11/6 hammer low (181.14) on the heaviest volume (10.4M) since the 11/5 flush. Catalyst: a CMS proposal to expand Medicare Advantage audits (UNH -10.2%, HUM -13.0% on 11/18), a policy shock to XLV's managed-care weight. Per playbook §3 and §7, close-triggered exits may be submitted after hours; XLV has no extended session, so this executes at the 11/19 open. Mark +$74.20 (+4.6%) vs SPY -5.1% over the same window.

The breakout add closes with tranche 1 on the same signal: 11/18 regular close 181.18 < 184.5 trail, after the CMS managed-care policy shock. Executes at the 11/19 open (no extended session for XLV). Mark +$6.07 (+1.7%) vs SPY ~-5.3% over the same window.
